modelOverview: The RM UP-01 Ferrari, unveiled in 2022 as the first fruit of Richard Mille's partnership with Ferrari, is an ultra-flat mechanical watch just 1.75mm thick. Rather than a concept piece, it was engineered as a wearable watch that passes the brand's standard validation tests, with a monobloc grade 5 titanium case, a 1.18mm manual-winding movement and a patented ultra-flat escapement.

RM UP-01.movement: Manual · Richard Mille Calibre RMUP-01 · 1.18mm thick · patented ultra-flat escapement with titanium balance · function selector · 28,800vph · ~45h power reserve
RM UP-01.materials: Monobloc grade 5 titanium case, satin-brushed with polished bevels, with black ceramic inserts; rubber strap; approximately 30 grams complete
RM UP-01.dial: Separate sapphire-covered apertures for the off-centre hours and minutes counter and the visible balance wheel, with a winding and hand-setting function selector
RM UP-01.description: The RM UP-01 Ferrari was the thinnest mechanical watch in the world at its launch, its 1.75mm titanium case and 1.18mm movement made possible by a patented ultra-flat escapement and a movement that forms part of the case structure. Hours and minutes sit in a recessed counter under their own sapphire window, with the balance visible under a second, in a limited edition of 150 pieces. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Ferrari Ultraflat: The RM UP-01 Ferrari as launched in 2022 — 1.75mm monobloc grade 5 titanium case, manual-winding Calibre RMUP-01 with ultra-flat escapement and function selector, limited to 150 pieces.
